title: Amid All-Star campaign, Angels’ Mike Trout (hamstring) to go on IL: Sources
content:
Los Angeles Angels superstar Mike Trout is headed to the injured list with a hamstring injury, team sources told The Athletic on Thursday.

Trout, 34, was in the midst of a comeback season in which he’d posted an .866 OPS with 17 home runs. He was also poised to start his 12th All-Star game, with early voting totals placing him in second place among American League outfielders.

The severity of the injury is unclear, as is his ability to return before the All-Star Game. Despite a lengthy injury history over the last several seasons, Trout had only been given one off day so far in 2026. It came in April after he was hit by a pitch.

In his place, the Angels called up infielder Christian Moore, the club’s 2024 first-round pick. Over 51 games at Triple A, Moore posted a 1.053 OPS.
